risk_note: RV1 (catalog). Hot list rank = the channel's original position (D10-422 ②, BR-TEXT-17 联盟物料频道). When the wiring drops an entry without a product key or of another platform, the upstream page carries positions (parallel to items, omitted when nothing was dropped or the page emptied); getHotRank ranks first + position + 1 across pages, without reordering; the hot list cache stores positions and treats bad stored ones as unreadable. The frozen hot-rank and hot-rank-upstream tests fix the page and candidate shapes, so positions is an optional page-level field, not on the candidate; a stored page without positions stays readable, which supersedes the ledger comment. Only the requested pageSize of a channel page counts, so positions cannot overlap the next page. No money moves; the whitelist is empty today, so production still answers rank_unavailable first. verify:fast exit 0 on the task's code (spec-tests 20335 pass). Earlier verify:fast runs failed for causes outside the implementation: a kit type error (fixed in a test(spec) commit), a unit-test fixture without a key prefix (fixed), and tools ops/task.test.ts timing out at 30 s on one slow runner (reported to the orchestrator; 22.5 s on another runner). Codex was unavailable until 11-02, so the rule tests and reviews ran on fresh independent Claude contexts (approvals id 36).
